scope: Canonical typed relationship graph for 33 active scientific repositories. Evidence ownership remains repository-local; V3 and PAYOFF are newly audited active nodes.

relation_types.handoff: later project starts from a bounded object/question/receipt left by earlier project
relation_types.epistemic: ordered scientific questions without software/data dependency or retroactive validation
relation_types.abstraction: specific scientific problem or object is lifted to a more general theory/method
relation_types.provenance: developmental ancestry/origin relation, not current scientific dependence
relation_types.complement: projects solve complementary parts of a larger task without evidence transfer
relation_types.component: parallel companion supplies one declared obligation to a synthesis hub
relation_types.information_flow: bounded scientific/operational object passes in the stated direction
relation_types.shared_substrate: same taxon/archive/data/system under different frozen contracts; no conclusion transfer

vertical_programmes.surface: present phenotype -> public evolutionary history -> own-data discrimination
WHEN/WHERE -> conditional response WHY -> focal phenotype axes
SHARED COORDINATE -> MIDDLE WORLD -> DIFFERENTIATED COORDINATES
vertical_programmes.firewall: PAYOFF is a game-theoretic abstraction over these three chapter-owned payoff objects; it is not Chapter 4 and does not acquire their empirical claims.

vertical_programmes.surface: mechanistic finite-state parent -> relational state/warning extension

relations.meaning: physical primary record -> blinded observer-system physical diagnosis
PolliPi V3 lineage -> standalone generic reference-refinement method
retained reference information before record-entry support selection

nonlinear_constellations.firewall: V3 is not V13 succession; REC->TNOA is information flow while TNOA->REC is development lineage.

relations.meaning: shared conflict load L -> architecture payoff generator
static middle-world margin Phi -> invasion/coordination game layer
recoverable loss R and architecture cost K -> population architecture payoff

nonlinear_constellations.firewall: PAYOFF adds population frequency feedback and game dynamics; it does not validate natural frequency dependence or historical architecture transitions.

horizontal_bridges.meaning: specific mechanism-allocation identified set -> general mechanistic identification boundary
what can be identified -> which next observation reduces remaining ambiguity

cross_program_operational_bridges.surface: WHAT to sample <-> WHERE to look

ecosystem_system.surface: VARIATION <-> STATE <-> RECORD <-> INFERENCE <-> NEXT OBSERVATION <-> FIELD RETURN
ecosystem_system.rule: All 33 active scientific repositories belong to one ecological research system, but connection never transfers ownership.

lens_only_no_edge.difference: reference refinement != record entry != post-entry semantics
trait-architecture middle world != finite eco-genetic criticality != general required-state theory
evolutionary architecture game != contract-relative state theory

philosophy_path.surface: origin -> record -> boundary -> next observation -> empirical return -> forgetting -> pass forward
